Definition: the presence, i.e. (adverbially) in front of
BiblicalUsage: The word means in front of, and its one use is violent: Shallum conspired against Zechariah and smote him before the people, in the open, and reigned in his stead.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the openness of it as part of the point: in those days kings were struck down where everyone could see.
